title: Shortcodes: Embed Images and Links in Your Text | Orchard Core
description:
Some of what a page shows depends on the site, such as a picture from the media library or the address of a file.

A shortcode is a small tag in square brackets that you type into the text. The site replaces it when it displays the page. This video uses the image and asset_url shortcodes in the editor of an article, from picking a file to the published page.

In this video:
• What a shortcode is
• Insert an image from the media library
• Options of the image shortcode: size and alternative text
• Choose a shortcode from the list of available shortcodes
• Where shortcodes work
